host_validation.banc_reference: Original-JavaScript fixture parity: 20 selector outputs and 16 reinforcement gains; graph ablation; two-success acquisition gate
host_validation.recording_fixtures: Existing supplied native recording frames and synthetic negatives, including iterative repair and actual Video6687 pixel alignment

legacy_full_group.reason: The four optional legacy recordings required by Video6651/6662/6666/6669ReplayTest are absent from supplied v1.72 source; their historical tests remain available.

implemented.banc_native_selector: Figure3g aggregate six nodes / 16 edges / six propagation ticks, engineered UI bindings
implemented.autonomy: two independent anchors, two fresh result frames, unique state, bounded repeated transition input, verified local skill memory
implemented.cross_game_transfer: success/failure and response-time statistics only; target-specific images, coordinates, graph identities and history retained separately
implemented.recording_loop: decode locally -> diagnose against current graph -> inherit reviewed local operation -> compile incremental repair -> compare again -> reviewed apply -> reanalyse same or next recording
implemented.mixed_coordinates: per-region windowLocal anchors, landmark alignment before point/path dispatch
implemented.frozen_single_state: diagnosis only when the recording shows no transition
implemented.video_end: continued observation; no implicit terminal/daily completion

unverified: Android video picker and persistent URI permission behavior
MediaMetadataRetriever on actual selected phone recordings
actual accessibility node discovery and targeted click/gesture execution
stalled-game recovery on F-52A and Chromebook
actual runtime speed, thermal behavior and battery usage

limits: Unseen canvas actions or ambiguous input locations require recording review or demonstration.
Recording-based validation checks the recorded observations; it does not prove future device success.
BANC import is a bounded selector and feedback mechanism, not an OCR engine, general language model or full-brain simulation.

reproduction.source_dependencies: Included ecj.jar, Java source, Java libs, native libs, test fixtures and existing development signing key; Android SDK/build-tools35.0.0 and Java17 required.
